name: AccuWeather
tagline: Enterprise-grade forecasts, severe weather alerts, and lifestyle indices via API
description: AccuWeather provides enterprise-grade weather data APIs including current conditions, forecasts, severe weather alerts, location services, and lifestyle indices. Developers can obtain free limited API keys for evaluation; production use typically requires a paid plan with higher call volumes and commercial licensing.

auth.details: API key passed as apikey query parameter on every request; self-serve signup at developer.accuweather.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: Limited free developer key (historically ~50 calls/day on Standard trial; confirm current limits at signup)
pricing.paid_plans: Contact sales for commercial/enterprise packages with higher volume

rate_limits: Varies by subscription tier; free/trial keys are heavily limited (see portal after signup)
use_cases: get current weather conditions for a city by location key
look up location key from city name or geocoordinates
get multi-day daily forecasts for a location
retrieve severe weather alerts for a region
fetch hourly forecasts for short-term planning
